definition: Croissant is a metadata format design to support sharing of datasets for machine learning applications.
details: It is a platform-agnostic schema used to standardize metadata in data repositories like Hugging Face, kaggle, Dataverse and OpenML.
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. Think of it this way: Croissant is a metadata format design to support sharing of datasets for machine learning applications. And here is the clever part: It is a platform-agnostic schema used to standardize metadata in data repositories like Hugging Face, kaggle, Dataverse and OpenML. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. And that is Croissant (metadata format) — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
